scope: Mass-specific V4.6 donor bank, Mass-relevant core bank roles, modern 19 October candidate studies, reviewed/posture SVGs; excludes unrelated UI/module art
rules: An artwork may represent multiple cues when its depiction is ceremonially accurate; otherwise use concise text.
Hash-based dedup for V46 uses verified Git blob SHA-1; this is not SHA-256 and cannot prove cross-format visual identity.
Retain A-P in Final Comparison 01; variants depict distinguishable actions or perspectives; neither replaces the other automatically.
Older/rejected/reserve-only images must never be resurrected via semantic aliases or other filenames.
An icon's visual approval does not permit the app to change source-owned ritual actions, posture triggers, priest/faithful ownership, or liturgical-form variants.
The profile decides head/body/profound bow rubrics even when one approved visual is reused.
No reviewed icons are activated by this file. Missing modern SVG masters must be imported and inspected separately.
Some bank gallery paths no longer exist on main: do not assume availability until source paths are resolved.
Where later actions target one liturgical slot, preserve broader icon bank status unless user explicitly rejected the image.
Do not confuse 1962 priest Communion with giving a chalice to the laity or Host elevation with Offertory presentation.
